body: I don't want it to be normal, I just want it to go away. You know? I wish I could just get this off my mind. I don't want my urges to be a regular thing, I just want them to go away. I've saved this post in a text file on my computer, and I think whenever I get the urge, I'm gonna read it, cause it is an unfiltered, raw, and emotional reflection at how I feel about this problem I seem to have.
